$comment: Repo-root Vercel config so the build runs from the repository ROOT and web/ can import ../shared WITHOUT needing the 'Include files outside the Root Directory' toggle. Set the Vercel project's Root Directory to EMPTY (the repo root). installCommand/buildCommand cd into web/ so only web's deps are installed (never the root Electron tool's native deps) and vite resolves ../shared. If you instead set Root Directory to 'web', this file is ignored and web/vercel.json applies (that path needs the toggle). Keep the connect-src here in sync with web/vercel.json and VITE_CLOUD_API.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co https://share.rcpz.tools https://pz-studio-cloud.rcpz.workers.dev; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
